asr.full_text: Hi there! As of now, Polkadot is dropping by 2.5% today It's time to look through the Wyckoff lens and see what are the whales doing If you're new to my sessions I will cover Wyckoff stage, the potential price trend change as well as the price levels And these are educational content and not financial advice A weekly chart of Polkadot It's still going for a very deep level of text So during the accumulation cycle all these orange tags over here we're still within it it's the mid-late stage of the accumulation cycle and what's coming during this cycle or what's the purpose of this cycle is that the whales are shaking out the paper hands and only the diamond hands remain cycle is that the whales are shaking out the paper hens and only the diamond hens remain Why is that? So, people may buy the dip at any point in time or when the price rebounds, and they ride the rally So at those points, the whales will sell and push the price down and those paper hens will sell along the way. When the price drop enough, the whales will slowly scoop in a significant amount. So at those points, that's where they have gathered strength or bullets in order to push the price to the next distribution cycle. That's the purpose of this, while the market is still going through a pretty low period. These kinds of fluctuations can still let the whales make a bit of gains while they make the bigger gains in other assets. Given a big picture, we're looking to see the sign of strength. So something in the chart when you look at it, it's basically a bunch of white candlesticks plus a series of, you know, higher than average volume bars like what happened over here back in 2023. As of now that hasn't come in yet. We hope to see a volume bar like what happened back in early November with, a more healthy white candlestick or multiple candlesticks that comes back to challenge at least the 5.2 Key level. Why 5.2? Because that's the trading range taught set during the automatic rally all right after the panic over a period the speculators investors whales set this trading range top so you see back in September last year it came to almost re-challenged that level but obviously failed to the point during the tariff announcement so maybe some people know something is coming That's why they thought out early just a pure speculation Going into the daily chart So from the downtrend that exited back in, back right after Christmas We go through a sideways trend So right now is between the 1.52 and 2.28 So these two levels even the 0.96 to even pessimistic case it's pretty much set by the October 10th event. All right? In the history of HoverBot, only one time back in 2022, it has reached lower than 1.52, got all the way to almost 1.4, but never reached the point below one dollar However october 10th this so we have to have this reference levels In this daily chart you don't see where this comes from because when I draw the chart I went lower to more frequent time intervals to get these support levels Last week we talked about this trend line assuming that an uptrend was going on the BuS has been fighting hard all through those four five weeks trying to build the case but they failed just five days ago on the 25th right after our session that confirmed this downtrend not downtrend, sorry, this uptrend is over and what changed from that is that we have an uptrend no im swapping the words we have a downtrend my brain needs a reboot so i'm trying to do multiple things at the same time, that's why I'm trying to draw these lines so we can get to the box. Here what I'm trying to show you is that if we go through this back trend Ok There are tops over there All these, we want to capture them as well as these wicks Ok, so assuming this is what it is Let's extend this as well because we are getting quite close to that point so assuming we extend this all the way and it's going to come down worst case scenario we have three cases over here, one this current point let's draw this line Set back in Christmas with they stand the line That's where the bulls are defending That's 1.68 a little bit above the 1.52 we talked about If the bulls are successful in defending this A&M continues to trade sideways for about a week or so, when we get to the 11th, less than two weeks, that's the very first opportunity to confirm that this downtrend is over and the sideways trend continues. However, if the bulls fail and it really comes down to test the $1.52, which did not happen during December. One week later the 18th is the second opportunity or the trend change confirmation to happen. However, if negative news really comes in, across the board today for crypto, there's a piece of red sea with only one or two exceptions. Precious metals has been hit hard as well. So, here, if all sorts of negative news Precious Medals has been hit hard as well So here If all sorts of negative news really comes in There is points till the middle of March If the price really comes back down, to retest the Tariff Announcement Day level we have another six weeks to wait before the trend change confirmation would come, alright So if you're interested to get access to these sessions 2 days earlier than the others, feel free to join the channel membership now, I'm moving on to Mia next See you in another video Bye
